name: manymotions-pitch-deck-generator
description: Turn your startup's description, problem, market and business model into six pitch deck slide visuals (problem, solution, market, product, business model and the ask) designed as one deck, produced as images in your ManyMotions account.

interface.longDescription:
Turn your startup into six pitch deck slide visuals designed as one deck.

Describe what the startup does, the problem it solves, its target market and how it makes money. The plugin prepares the request and shows the credits it will use. When you confirm, ManyMotions plans the deck and renders six slides: problem, solution, market, product, business model and the ask. A deck takes a few minutes; ChatGPT reports the progress and returns the links to the slide images.

For founders and startup teams preparing a first investor or demo-day deck.

Limitations: the slides are images, not an editable presentation file, and they are built only from the description you give; check every figure on them before you use them. It does not use uploaded decks, logos or images, and it does not put other companies' logos or trademarks on the slides. Producing a deck uses your signed-in ManyMotions account; preparing a request does not need an account.

ManyMotions is the platform formerly known as ClipWave.
capabilities: Track progress and return the slide images
defaultPrompt: Pitch deck: we rent solar kits to apartment renters stuck with high power bills and earn from the rentals
Six slides: an inventory app that cuts food waste for independent restaurants, which license it from us
Investor deck: a marketplace where families find vetted local tutors fast; we take a commission per lesson

positive.prompt: Pitch deck for my startup: we rent plug-in solar kits to apartment renters, who pay high power bills but cannot install panels; the market is renters in sunny cities; we charge a monthly rental fee. Only prepare it and show me the settings and the credits; don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A request with the startup, the problem, the market and the business model, and the credits it will use. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.prompt: Six slides for our B2B app that automates inventory so restaurants stop wasting food and running out of stock; customers are independent restaurants; sold as a monthly subscription. Only prepare it and show me the settings and the credits; don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A request with the four parts of the startup and the credits required. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Produce a deck and return it
positive.prompt: Pitch deck for a startup that delivers refillable cleaning products by bike; it solves plastic waste from single-use bottles; customers are city households; revenue from a monthly refill plan. Yes, generate it now and send me the slide links when they are ready.
positive.expected_behavior: The request is prepared and the credits required are shown. After the go-ahead (if ChatGPT asks to confirm first, reply "Generate it"), generate_result starts one run in the signed-in account (state processing). get_result reports the steps completed; asked again once the run has completed (usually within a few minutes), it returns the absolute links of the six slide images and the ManyMotions link to open it.

positive.prompt: Investor deck visuals for a marketplace that matches families with vetted local tutors, because finding a good tutor takes weeks; the market is families with school-age children; we take a commission on each lesson. Only prepare it and show me the settings and the credits; don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A request with the four parts of the startup and the credits required. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.prompt: Pitch deck for a startup making a sensor that warns farmers when soil is too dry, since over-watering wastes water and money; the market is small and mid-size farms; we sell the sensor plus a yearly data plan. Only prepare it and show me the settings and the credits; don't generate it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: A request with the four parts of the startup and the credits required. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

negative.prompt: Redesign the PowerPoint deck I attached with a new color scheme.
Add a comparison slide with the logos of the big tech companies we compete with.
Write the speaker notes for a five-minute investor pitch.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Producing a deck uses credits of the user's existing ManyMotions account; no purchase happens in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a request, produce a deck in the linked ManyMotions account and follow it to the slide images.
